PRIVACY POLICY

Your data.
Plain and simple.

Effective September 14, 2026. Flap Fit is operated by Troy Reardon.

Information kept on your phone

Flap Fit stores your selected bird, game progress, scores, tracked training time, exercise history, and settings on your device. This local information is not sent to Flap Fit unless an optional online feature described below requires it. You can remove local information by clearing the app's data or deleting the app.

Camera and Record & Play

Flap Fit uses the front camera during gameplay to estimate body landmarks and translate movement into bird movement. Pose estimation runs on your device using a model bundled with the app. During normal Play, Flap Fit does not record or upload camera images.

If you select Record & Play, Flap Fit can request microphone permission and create a video containing the camera view, game graphics, your voice, and workout sounds. The video remains in temporary app storage so you can use your device's share sheet. Flap Fit does not upload or receive the video or audio. A destination you choose processes the video under its own privacy terms. The temporary file is removed when you leave the result screen or begin another run, subject to normal operating-system cache behavior.

Optional online competition

You can play Flap Fit without using Compete. If you accept the Competition Terms and use Compete, Flap Fit creates an anonymous authentication identifier and processes your chosen player name, exercise category, leaderboard score, challenge codes and results, reports, blocks, and ordinary service or security logs.

We use this information to operate leaderboards and challenges, keep your anonymous profile working, enforce community rules, prevent abuse, investigate reports, secure the service, and comply with law. Player names and competition results can be public to other players. Camera images, Record & Play videos, and your complete local training history are not sent to the competition service.

Service providers and transfers

Supabase provides authentication, database hosting, and server functions for Compete. The website host delivers these pages. These providers may process ordinary account, request, security, and connection information where they and their subprocessors operate. We use service providers to operate Flap Fit, not to sell personal information.

Flap Fit 1.0 contains no advertising SDK, added analytics SDK, purchases, or cross-app tracking. Health and fitness information is not used for advertising, marketing profiles, or data brokerage.

Retention and deletion

Local information remains until you clear app data or delete the app. Online profiles and current leaderboard scores remain until you delete the online profile. Challenges expire after 30 days and are removed with their attempts by the production cleanup process. Pending reports remain until review. Resolved moderation reports are removed after 180 days. If an associated account is deleted sooner, its user identifier is removed from the report. Provider security logs and backups follow the production provider's configured retention.

In the app, open Info and select Delete online profile to delete the anonymous competition account and its associated profile, scores, challenges, attempts, and blocks. Local game progress stays on your device. If you no longer have the app, follow the account and data deletion instructions.

Your choices and rights

You may decline camera permission, decline optional Record & Play microphone permission, use normal Play instead of Record & Play, avoid Compete, block another player, report public competition content, or delete your online profile. Depending on where you live, you may also have rights to request access, correction, restriction, objection, or deletion.

For privacy questions or data requests, contact awesome-eh@hotmail.com.

Children, safety, and changes

Flap Fit is intended for people aged 13 and older and is not directed to children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child under 13 provided information through Compete.

Flap Fit is a fitness game, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. We may update this policy when the app, service, or law changes. Material changes will be posted here with a new effective date, and renewed consent will be requested when required.
